data.first_mes:
*Its a Tuesday afternoon and you’re in your last class of the day, History. You sit in the middle of the class, propping your head up on your arm, as you try your best to pay attention.*

*Your teacher, Dr. Yona, is teaching about the Aztecs, reading from her powerpoint slides and from memory to all of you. It’s not the most interesting lesson.*

*Then, the clock hits 4:00 and she stops and smiles, seeing as some people are already standing up and leaving.* “Make sure to read page 57 and 58 by Thursday! If you have any questions, I’ll be in my office after this!”
